policy: Unweighted polynomial least squares includes every power0throughdegree. For candidates whose every leave-one-out training design has full column rank, compute predictions by refitting after leaving out each whole row and average squared errors. PRESS residual/(1-h_ii) is an equivalent computation when its denominator is nonzero. A candidate that loses full column rank on any leave-one-out split has no unique ordinary least-squares leave-one-out prediction and is ineligible; report null, not zero or an arbitrary minimum-norm extrapolation. Ties within1e-10 use smaller degree.
scope: Four fixed controlled readings. The score concerns this leave-one-out protocol only; endpoint omissions can test extrapolation relative to a fold. It is not independent deployment validation.
answer_contract_note: The nullable MSE fields are required because full-rank eligibility must be checked.
